rpg.europa.class.warrior.desc: Melee tank: more health, armor and damage.
rpg.europa.class.mage.desc: Ranged magic: large mana pool and fast regen.
rpg.europa.class.rogue.desc: Stealthy and fast: quick attacks and mobility.
rpg.europa.class.ranger.desc: Archer: masters ranged combat with the bow.
rpg.europa.subclass.berserker.desc: Savage warrior focused on raw damage.
rpg.europa.subclass.pyromancer.desc: Master of fire and area destruction.
rpg.europa.subclass.cryomancer.desc: Controls the field with ice and slowness.
rpg.europa.subclass.assassin.desc: Eliminates single targets with lethal strikes.

quest.europa.deep_forge.desc: Turn in 4 Adamantite Ingots (ore below Y -20).
quest.europa.soul_harvest.desc: Turn in 6 Soul Shards (Soulstone Ore in the Nether).
quest.europa.catacomb_lord.desc: Find a Catacomb (/locate structure europa:catacomb), use the key on the altar and defeat the boss.

rpg.europa.screen.title: Character
rpg.europa.screen.hover_hint: Hover a class to see details.
rpg.europa.class.cleric.desc: Holy healer: sustains the party and punishes the undead.
rpg.europa.class.necromancer.desc: Raises undead servants and drains enemies' life.
rpg.europa.class.druid.desc: Controls the field with nature's roots and thorns.
rpg.europa.class.monk.desc: Martial artist: swift blows, stronger when unarmed.
rpg.europa.class.bard.desc: Support: songs that empower allies and confuse foes.
rpg.europa.class.alchemist.desc: Throws volatile flasks and brews powerful elixirs.
rpg.europa.class.runesmith.desc: Inscribes runes: traps, armor and arcane turrets.
rpg.europa.class.voidweaver.desc: Bends space: teleportation and collapsing gravity.
rpg.europa.subclass.hierophant.desc: Consecrates the ground: continuous party healing.
rpg.europa.subclass.inquisitor.desc: Relentless judge: holy lightning on a single target.
rpg.europa.subclass.legion_lord.desc: Commands an army of the dead.
rpg.europa.subclass.shapeshifter.desc: Takes the form of a colossal beast.
rpg.europa.subclass.grove_warden.desc: Ancestral roots bind foes and heal allies.
rpg.europa.subclass.iron_fist.desc: Strike flurries that ignore the target's guard.
rpg.europa.subclass.minstrel.desc: Ballads that regenerate and shield the party.
rpg.europa.subclass.discordant.desc: Chaotic notes that turn enemies on each other.
rpg.europa.subclass.transmuter.desc: Elixirs that transform the body itself.
rpg.europa.subclass.arcane_architect.des: Builds rune turrets that fire on their own.
rpg.europa.subclass.void_devourer.desc: A rift that consumes foes and returns mana.
rpg.europa.ability.charge.desc: Dash forward and strike everything ahead.
rpg.europa.ability.blood_rage.desc: Strength II, Speed II, Haste II and Regeneration for 10 s.
rpg.europa.ability.divine_shield.desc: Heals and shields nearby allies; burns the undead.
rpg.europa.ability.arcane_missile.desc: Instant magic bolt at your target.
rpg.europa.ability.meteor.desc: A meteor strikes the targeted spot after 1 s (no block damage).
rpg.europa.ability.blizzard.desc: Freezes and weakens everything within 8 blocks.
rpg.europa.ability.shadow_step.desc: Teleport behind the target and turn invisible.
rpg.europa.ability.death_mark.desc: Massive magic strike + Wither on the target.
rpg.europa.ability.smoke_bomb.desc: Blinds nearby enemies; you turn invisible and fast.
rpg.europa.ability.piercing_shot.desc: Pierces every enemy in a line (64 blocks).
rpg.europa.ability.restoring_light.desc: Heals you and nearby allies and removes poison, wither and weakness.
rpg.europa.ability.sanctuary.desc: Consecrates the area for 10 s: heals allies and burns undead every second.
rpg.europa.ability.judgment.desc: Holy lightning on the target; double damage to undead.
rpg.europa.ability.raise_servant.desc: Raises an undead servant for 45 s (max 2).
rpg.europa.ability.blood_pact.desc: Damages all within 6 blocks and heals half the damage dealt.
rpg.europa.ability.thorn_snare.desc: Roots the target in place and poisons it.
rpg.europa.ability.beast_form.desc: For 20 s: +8 health, Strength II, Resistance and Speed.
rpg.europa.ability.ancestral_roots.desc: Roots and damages foes within 8 blocks; regenerates allies.
rpg.europa.ability.seismic_palm.desc: A strike that hurls the target; +50% damage when unarmed.
rpg.europa.ability.hundred_strikes.desc: Six rapid strikes that ignore the target's invulnerability.
rpg.europa.ability.wind_step.desc: Long leap + Speed III, Slow Falling and Jump Boost for 8 s.
rpg.europa.ability.song_of_valor.desc: Allies within 10 blocks gain Strength and Speed.
rpg.europa.ability.restoring_ballad.desc: Regeneration II and Absorption II for the party.
rpg.europa.ability.dissonant_chord.desc: Enemies become weak, slow, nauseous and attack each other.
rpg.europa.ability.volatile_flask.desc: Throws a flask of poison, slowness and weakness.
rpg.europa.ability.toxic_cloud.desc: Poison III and wither cloud for 10 s at the target spot.
rpg.europa.ability.perfect_elixir.desc: Absorption III, Regeneration II, Strength, Speed and fire resistance.
rpg.europa.ability.explosive_rune.desc: Etches a rune that explodes when an enemy steps on it (20 s).
rpg.europa.ability.runic_armor.desc: Resistance II and Absorption III for 15 s.
rpg.europa.ability.rune_turret.desc: An arcane turret fires at the nearest enemy for 15 s.
rpg.europa.ability.void_rift.desc: Teleports up to 10 blocks where you look.
rpg.europa.ability.stellar_collapse.desc: Pulls enemies into a point and detonates after 1 s.
rpg.europa.ability.devouring_rift.desc: For 3 s damages nearby foes; each hit restores 3 mana.
rpg.europa.talent.bloodthirst.desc: Converts %s of damage dealt into health per rank.
rpg.europa.talent.steadfast.desc: +%s toughness and 5%% knockback resistance per rank.
rpg.europa.talent.second_wind.desc: Regenerates %s health every 5 s per rank.
rpg.europa.talent.last_stand.desc: Survive a lethal blow with 2 hearts (120 s cooldown). %s
rpg.europa.talent.overload.desc: %s chance for an ability to skip its cooldown.
rpg.europa.talent.status.needs_previous: Requires the previous talent in this branch.
